title: Double chocolate protein pudding
description: Thick no-cook chocolate pudding made from double chocolate protein powder, cocoa and Greek yogurt.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Not plannable until the powder's carbs and fat per scoop are filled in (A2).

steps.text: Measure the protein powder, cocoa and milk into a mixing bowl.
Whisk the protein powder, cocoa and milk into a smooth paste with no dry lumps.
Fold the paste into the Greek yogurt with the vanilla until evenly chocolate.
Divide into 2 cups and chill at least 30 minutes before serving.
